verses.text: Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', a winhaj Judá ix spojel sb'a winh t'a heb' yuk'tak, ix b'at kajnaj winh t'a slak'anil jun winh winak skuchan Hira, aj chonhab' Adulam.
Hata' ix yiloch ix yisil jun winh aj Canaán skuchan Súa winh, ix yik'lan sb'a winh yet' ix.
Ix skuchanoch yune' ix. Ayik ix alji yune' ix chi', Er ix sb'iej.
Ixlajwi chi' ix skuchanxioch yune' ix. Ayik ix alji yune' ix chi', Onán ix yak' ix sb'iej.
Ix skuchanoch junxo yune' ix. Ayik ix alji, Sela ix yak' ix sb'iej. Ha t'a Quezib ayek' winhaj Judá chi' ayik ix alji winh unin chi'.
Haxo yik ix kelemax winhaj Er b'ab'el unin chi', ix sayji yetb'eyum winh yuj winhaj Judá chi', ix yik'an ix Tamar winh.
Te chuk ix yutej sb'a winhaj Er chi' t'a yichanh Jehová, yuj chi' ix cham winh yuj.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Judá t'a winhaj Onán icha tik: --Ik'laj a b'a yet' ix yetb'eyum winh uk'tak chamnak, tza k'anab'ajej ko ley, ichato yinhtilal winh uk'tak chi' ol elkan uuj yet' ix, xchi winhaj Judá chi'.

Palta yojtak winhaj Onán chi' to a unin ol aljok chi', manh yikok winh ol aj yet' ix smu' chi', yuj chi' juntak el sway winh yet' ix, haxo yinhatil winh syak'kanem winh t'a sat lu'um yik max och ix yab'ixal, yik wach' max elkanlaj yinhtilal winh yuk'tak winh chi' snaani.
Ha tas ix sk'ulej winh chi', chuk t'a sat Jehová, yuj chi' ix cham winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Judá t'a ix yalib' chi' icha tik: --Ha tiknaik wach' tzach paxkan yet' a mam a nun. Malaj junokxo winak wach' tzik'a'. Hato yik ol k'och sk'inal winhaj Sela wuninal, ichato chi' ol yal ik'an a b'a yet' winh, xchi winhaj Judá chi'. Tonhej ix yal winh icha chi', q'uinalok schampax winhaj Sela chi' snaan winh, icha ix aj scham chawanh heb' winh yuk'tak. Icha chi' ix aj sb'at ix Tamar yik skajnaj ix yet' smam snun.

Pekatax chi' ix cham ix yetb'eyum winhaj Judá chi', ix yisil winhaj Súa. Ixlajwi yek'b'at skusk'olal winh, ix b'at winh t'a chonhab' Timnat b'aj wan sjoxchajel xil nok' skalnel, haxo jun winh yamigo winh skuchan Hira ix b'at yuk'lewok.
Haxo yik ix yab'an spekal ix Tamar to wan sb'at winhaj Judá t'a Timnat yil sjoxchajel nok' skalnel,

t'a elanhchamel ix yik'el spichul ix, haton k'apak syak'och heb' ix chamnak yetb'eyum. Ix yak'anoch jun smusil sat ix, yik wach' malaj mach snaaneli tato a ix. Ix em k'ojan ix t'a stiel chonhab' b'aj sk'och sb'eal chonhab' Enaim, t'a sb'eal Timnat chi'. Ix sk'ulej jun tik ix, yujto ix nachajel yuj ix to a winhaj Sela ix q'uib'el winh, palta maxto yik'laj sb'a winh yet' ix.
Ayik ix yilanb'at ix winhaj Judá chi', ix snaan winh to ajmul ix jun ix chi', yujto musab'il sat ix.

Ix el winhaj Judá chi' t'a yol b'e, ix b'at winh yilb'at ix. Manh yojtakok winh tato a ix yalib' winh. Ix yalan winh t'a ix icha tik: --¿Max am yal a k'ool tzin way het'ok? xchi winh. --Tato syal in k'ool ¿tas junok tzak' t'ayin? xchi ix.
--Ol wak'kot junok yune' a chiwa, xchi winh t'a ix. --Tzam yala', anhej tato ay junok tas tzak'kan t'ayin tiknaik. Ayik sjawi nok' in yune' chiwa chi', swak'anxi meltzaj t'ayach, xchi ix.

--¿Tas pax tza nib'ej swak'kan t'ayach? xchi winhaj Judá chi'. --Ak'kan a sello yet' sch'anhal yet' a k'okoch et'nak, xchi ix. --Syala', kanokab'i, xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix way winh yet' ix, ix skuchankanoch yune' ix.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at ix, ix yik'anel smusil sat ix chi', ix yak'anxioch sk'apak ix syak'och heb' ix chamnak yetb'eyum.

Ayik ix k'och winhaj Judá b'aj ayek' nok' skalnel chi', ix schekankot winh yamigo winh, haton winh aj Adulam, ix b'at yak'ankan nok' yune' chiwa chi' winh t'a ix ix chi' yik syik'paxta tas aykan chi' t'a ix yuj winhaj Judá chi' yalani, palta majxo ilchajlaj ix yuj winh schekab' win chi'.

Ix sk'anb'anek' winh t'a heb' aj chonhab' chi' icha tik: --¿B'ajtil ay jun ix ajmul ix t'a tik, jun ix tz'emnhej k'ojan t'a sti' sb'eal Enaim tik? xchi winh chekab' chi'. --Malaj junok ix ajmul ix t'a tik, xchi heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzajxi winh t'a winhaj Judá chi', ix yalan winh: --Majxo ilchajlaj ix wuuj, ix yal heb' winh ayek' chi' ta' to malaj junok ix ajmul ix b'aj ay heb' chi', xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Judá icha tik: --Kanokab' ix yet' juntzanh chi', yik wach' max el ko q'uixwelal. Ix in k'anab'ajej, ix wak'anb'at nok' yune' chiwa, anhej to majxo ilchaj ix uuj, xchi winh.

Yoxil xom ujal chi', ix b'at alchaj t'a winhaj Judá icha tik: --Ha ix Tamar, ix alib', ay am mach ix sk'umej ix, yuj chi' yab'ixxo ix tiknaik, xchi heb' winh t'a winh. Ix yalan winh: --Ik'ekel ix t'a stiel chonhab' yik tze nhusantz'a ix, xchi winh.

Ayik wan yik'jielta ix yuj heb' winh, ix yak'anb'at schekab' ix t'a winhaj Judá chi', ix yalan icha tik: Ha winh ay yik juntzanh swak'b'at tik, haton winh ay yik unin wet'nak tik. B'eyk'olej mach ay yik jun sello yet' sch'anhal tik yet' jun k'okoch tik, xchib'at ix t'a winh.

Ayik ix yilanoch winhaj Judá to yik masanil juntzanh chi' winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: Ha ix ix chi' wach' tas ix sk'ulej ix. Ha in chuk tas ix in k'ulej. Ay in mul. Maj wak'laj yik' sb'a ix yet' winh wuninal aj Sela, xchi winh. Yuj chi' maj nhusjitz'alaj ix. Majxo waylaj winh yet' ix junelxo.
Haxo ix b'o sk'ol ix Tamar chi', tiox heb' unin ix alji chi'.
Ayik wan yalji heb' unin chi', ayik ix elul sk'ab' jun b'ab'el, ix spixanoch jab' chak ch'al ix wetz'wajum t'a sjaj sk'ab' jun unin chi', ix yalan ix: Haton jun b'ab'el tik, xchi ix.
Palta ix yik'anxioch sk'ab' jun nene' chi', haxo junxo yuk'tak chi' ix alji sb'ab'elal, yuj chi' Fares ix sb'iej yuj ix wetz'wajum chi'. Ix yalan ix: ¿Tas yuj ix a b'ab'laj ekejelta a b'a? xchi ix.
Ixlajwi chi' ix alji winh nene' ayoch anh chak ch'al chi' t'a sjaj sk'ab', Zara ix sb'iej yuj ix.
